outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E stained tissue micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel C contains a box plot (exempt, distribution already shown) but also a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per mouse across diameter categories and genotypes; this bar chart of averages does not overlay individual mouse data points.
Panel D is a Kaplan–Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
The bar chart of GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels shows mean values with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
The bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows mean values with error bars and significance asterisks but no individual data points overlaid.
